chunks: And in the narration of Abān, from ʿUmar ibn Yazīd, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
I do not think that a man increases in faith and goodness except that he also increases in love for women.

key_terms.الْإِيمَانِ: faith; inward belief and religious conviction
key_terms.لِلنِّسَاءِ: for women; referring to affection toward women

ai.seo_question: How does increasing iman relate to love for women in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith links growth in iman with an increase in goodness and affection toward women. It presents such love as a quality associated with moral and spiritual refinement rather than a deficiency.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4351 - In a narration from Aban, from Umar ibn Yazid, Abu Abdillah (as) said: "
I do not think that a man increases in faith and goodness except that he also increases in love for women."
